audit_items.proof_trace: Every arithmetic operation in the interest accrual chain (mul_u64, mul, add) calls ensure_decimal_value_safe which aborts if the result exceeds VALUE_MAX_256 (U64_MAX * WAD ≈ 1.84e37). Intermediate u256 products never overflow u256 natively: max intermediate is (VALUE_MAX_256)^2 / WAD ≈ 3.38e74, well below u256_max (1.16e77). With realistic per-second rates (~47e-9 / WAD per second max), simple_interest_factor values remain orders of magnitude below the overflow threshold even over decades.
